title: CAI Content Credentials is affected by an Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path…
description: CAI Content Credentials suffers from a path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass security restrictions and access unauthorized files or directories. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as visiting a malicious URL or interacting with a compromised webpage. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.5.
